messages:
Lena (AE): CureWave confirmed a 2-node on-prem POC next Thursday. They want a short install + validation and an automatic fallback to hosted inference if the private route fails. Can we assemble a minimal preflight for infra + sec?
Ravi (SE): Yep. I'll own the docs. Quick: will they let us push the operator, or do they need to pull from their registry?
Lena (AE): They prefer to pull but can accept a signed tarball if needed.
Noah (Field Eng): Hardware/drivers: require kernel >= 5.15, NVIDIA driver >= 525.x for H100/A100 compatibility, CUDA >= 12.1. Ask for full `nvidia-smi` output and driver version string. Confirm whether GPUs use ECC and if NVLINK is present.
Hannah (Security): Security constraints: do not accept persistent kubeconfigs. If they provide a kubeconfig for bootstrap it must expire within 24h and be IP-restricted. Preferred: they create a namespaced ServiceAccount and supply the token + RBAC YAML. No cluster-admins. Also need a short note on cert/key custody (KMS/HSM provider, rotation cadence).
Bea (SRE): Network checklist: allow outbound to registry.redwood.ai:443, allow DNS (udp/53) and NTP (udp/123), and allow our fallback API hostnames on 443. If airgapped, we'll supply image tarballs + manifest and an import guide. Confirm MTU >= 1400 and whether there's an HTTP proxy for image pulls.
Ravi (SE): Kubernetes versions we support: 1.26-1.28. If they're on 1.25 or older, flag it and we can propose mitigations but can't guarantee behavior. Also confirm container runtime (containerd vs dockerd) and cgroup mode (cgroup v2 recommended).
Noah (Field Eng): Put these verification commands in the email for them to paste outputs:
```
# on each worker node
nvidia-smi -L
nvidia-smi -q | head -n 80
uname -r
cat /etc/os-release
# control plane
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl version --short
# runtime
crictl images | head -n 20
# kernel logs (watch for driver OOMs)
dmesg | tail -n 200
```
Hannah (Security): Also ask about OS hardening: are SELinux/AppArmor enforced? If SELinux is enforcing, note policies applied. Who manages node patching and what's the vulnerability patch cadence?
Bea (SRE): Observability: enable node syslog shipping or allow us to run a read-only sidecar for driver logs. We also need a path to push logs to our debug collector over HTTPS during the POC.
Ravi (SE): For bootstrap we can either: 1) accept a short-lived kubeconfig (24h + IP allowlist) or 2) they create `redwood-operator-sa` in `redwood-system` and give us token + RBAC. We'll provide minimal RBAC YAML in the packet.
Noah (Field Eng): Stress check (optional): run our tiny 2-worker CUDA test container to surface early allocation issues. We'll send the `docker run`/`ctr` commands in the playbook. Watch `dmesg` for GPU allocation failures or driver resets.
Lena (AE): Also include pricing note for spinning a short Dedicated pool vs using hosted fallback (metered). They'll want numbers.
Hannah (Security): If they insist we bring a kubeconfig for convenience, require an allowlist of source IPs and key expiration <=24h. No privileged tokens.
Ravi (SE): Edge cases: if they're using split-horizon DNS, operator imagePullSecrets or internal registry names can break. Ask them to provide an internal resolver example and any private suffix.
Bea (SRE): If their environment uses an internal proxy for HTTPS, confirm proxy credentials and certificate validation path. For airgapped installs we need tarballs and a signed manifest.
keybot: apiKey:create requested by Ravi (SE) -> created scoped key: curewave-poc-fallback (inference-only) expires=14d
Lena (AE): Perfect. I'll send the one-pager with checklist + copy/paste commands + RBAC snippet and schedule a 60m kickoff with infra + security + ops. Who can attend?
Bea (SRE): I can join first 20m for network/airgap and logging.
Noah (Field Eng): I'll join to run the driver checks and stress test.
Hannah (Security): I'll attend for RBAC and KMS questions.
Ravi (SE): I'll run the operator bootstrap steps.
Lena (AE): Thanks team. I'll circulate the email and ask them to return the command outputs by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
